name: OSINT — Corporate Ownership
description: Cross-jurisdiction corporate graph research with explicit provenance and identity matching.

tasks.name: Define seed entities and scope
tasks.objective: Record target companies/organizations, known identifiers, jurisdictions, relevant dates, research purpose, and the ownership/control question. Separate legal ownership, beneficial ownership, management, financing, and commercial relationship as different relation types.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Seed entities use identifiers and jurisdictions where possible, not names alone.

tasks.name: Collect authoritative filings
tasks.objective: Gather corporate registry extracts, annual accounts, incorporation/change filings, significant-control/beneficial-owner records where public, securities filings, regulator notices, gazettes, licenses, concessions, court records, and procurement records. Preserve filing dates and effective dates separately.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Ownership claims identify both source and effective period.

tasks.name: Resolve people and entities
tasks.objective: Reconcile names, aliases, transliterations, company numbers, addresses, dates, officers, and jurisdiction-specific identifiers across sources. Use graph context as supporting evidence but never merge two people or companies solely because names resemble each other.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every entity merge has positive matching evidence and recorded uncertainty.

tasks.name: Build ownership/control graph
tasks.objective: Model entities and dated relationships including ownership percentages, directors, signatories, subsidiaries, parent entities, intermediaries, trusts/foundations where documented, common addresses, assets, contracts, and payments where lawfully available. Preserve source provenance per edge/property.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Graph edges distinguish documented ownership from looser association.

tasks.name: Test beneficial control hypotheses
tasks.objective: Trace ownership chains, voting/control rights, nominee/intermediary patterns, related-party transactions, common management, and temporal changes. Treat inferred control as inference unless a source documents it.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Beneficial-control conclusions separate documentary fact from analyst inference.

tasks.name: Audit identity and provenance
tasks.objective: Independently challenge high-impact merges and ownership paths for stale filings, same-name collisions, reused addresses, historical directors, source duplication, jurisdictional differences, and missing effective dates.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Critical paths survive a second-pass entity-resolution audit.

tasks.name: Package corporate map
tasks.objective: Deliver an evidence-linked graph, timeline of ownership/control changes, source table, unresolved identities, confidence per important edge, and concise narrative answering the scoped ownership/control question without exposing irrelevant sensitive personal data.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every material relationship in the report can be traced to its source or labeled inference.
